name: Bun song than
summary: Mung-bean noodles from An Thái, named for the strands pulled in pairs, cooked with shrimp or lean pork. In An Thái the bowl comes with chicken offal.
origin: Phường Bình Định, thị xã An Nhơn. An old verse names An Thái.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl with shrimp, lean pork, or chicken offal, or buy dry noodles to take away.
Five kilos of beans make about one kilo of noodles, so the noodles are not cheap.
seoTitle: Bun Song Than — mung-bean noodles in An Nhon
seoDescription: Bún Song Thằn is mung-bean noodles from An Thái in An Nhơn, pulled in pairs and cooked with shrimp, lean pork, or chicken offal.
